Per project rules this is NOT a rejection: absence of retrievable data is not proof of non-existence, and no evidence of strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy was found either. Action required: re-run against MCA V3 / a paid registry API (Zauba/Tofler/Probe) with the exact CIN, and confirm whether the entity is 'Toyo Springs Limited' or a similarly named private limited company, since the input string repeats the same name 10 times and may be a deduplication artefact of several distinct supplier records.
